locale.description: System default locale. Empty (default) leaves the base image untouched. 'C.UTF-8' is built-in (no generation). Others like 'en_US.UTF-8' or 'ja_JP.UTF-8' are auto-generated via the locales package.

timezone.description: Timezone (e.g. 'Asia/Tokyo'). Empty (default) leaves the base image untouched.
